'''Missa''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] individual who served as the lady-in-waiting of the [[Noble/Legends|noblewoman]] [[Lady/Legends|Lady]] [[Kalena]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Kalena and Missa were traveling aboard the [[Corvette/Legends|corvette]] ''[[Indupar Nova]]'' when the [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] was boarded in the [[Ec Pand system/Legends|Ec Pand system]] by [[Rebel privateer]]s, and Kalena and Missa switched places, in an attempt to protect Kalena. However, [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Urias Xhaxin]] of the privateers saw through the deception and he ordered Kalena and Missa to be held in comfort aboard his ship, the ''[[Free Lance]]''.
